# DAX Instructions (Draft)

Verify the installed, organization-approved Copilot client supports this instruction-file format before relying on automatic application.

- Prefer explicit measures, readable formatting, descriptive variables, and safe division.
- Specify filter context, blank behavior, date context, exclusions, and business-definition traceability.
- Avoid unnecessary iterators and calculated columns; review performance in the target model before release.
- Include expected results for positive, negative, blank, and boundary cases. Do not claim execution unless tested in a verified engine.
